name: yuvava
description: An AI pair-programming navigator that observes your changes and points out problems — without writing your code.

enumDescriptions: GPT / Codex, via the OpenAI API.
navigator.provider.markdownDescription: Which service performs the review. Both are held to the same contract: the same prompt, the same response schema, and the same guarantee that Navigator never writes code.

navigator.model.markdownDescription: Model used for review. Leave empty for the provider's default (`claude-opus-5` for Anthropic, `gpt-5.1-codex-max` for OpenAI).

navigator.reviewIntensity.markdownDescription:
How much Navigator is allowed to speak up.

- `silent`: clear correctness bugs only
- `normal`: correctness, edge cases, risky design
- `strict`: adds security, performance, complexity and maintainability

No intensity ever allows Navigator to generate code.

navigator.diffBase.markdownDescription: Git revision the working tree is diffed against, e.g. `HEAD` or `origin/main`.

navigator.includeUntracked.markdownDescription: Also review new files git is not tracking yet. Files ignored by `.gitignore` are never included, and Navigator reads them without ever writing to the index.

navigator.maxDiffBytes.markdownDescription: Diffs larger than this are not sent for review.

navigator.maxObservations.markdownDescription: Upper bound on observations reported for a single review.

scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run compile && node --test "out/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.package: npm run compile && vsce package -o yuvava.vsix
scripts.install:local: npm run verify && npm run package && code --install-extension yuvava.vsix --force && echo Installed. Run Developer: Reload Window in VS Code to activate it.
